description: Na₄V₂C₄SO₁₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fddd space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.57 Å. V is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.09 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond lengths. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All S-O bond lengths are 1.50 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one V, and one C atom.
